series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

progress.text: The most recent level of indicator is 1.9% below the Base year and 24.3% below the 1990 GHG emission levels

target_text.text: Total GHG emissions correspond to the annual totals reported in CO2 equivalents excluding LULUCF in the latest national GHG inventory. The totals comprise all sectors and gases listed in the CTF table entitled ‘Reporting format for the description of a Party’s nationally determined contribution under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement, including updates'

reference_text.text: Base year: 2010 - During the revision of the first NDC, the calculation of the greenhouse gas inventory and quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes identified the 2010 as the base year. In order to make comparisons with the first and the second NDC and changes in the greenhouse gases (hereinafter: GHG), the GHG emission is expressed compared to 1990. The reference level in the base year (2010) is 63 800 ktCO2eq considering NDC target is expressed also as emission reduction compared to 1990, the reference level in 1990 is 82 667 ktCO2eq

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-09-12. 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 60.9 MtCO₂e, DS-35 42.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 50.5 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 9.8% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to 1990 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.53°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.25°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
